Quick Cleaning


Code
data <- read.csv("../Raw/Healthcare+Intervention+-+Control+Pilot+(SU24)_June+11,+2024_15.46.csv")

data <- data[-c(1:2),]
data <- data %>% 
  select(-c(1:8, 
            10:17,
            27:43,
            67:77,
            81:84))

data <- data %>% 
  select(-c(52:55))

write.csv(data, "../Analyses/Control-Pilot_Clean_Wide.csv")




Code
data$ResponseId <- as.factor(data$ResponseId)

longData <- 
  data %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = treatment_1:notes_2,
    names_to = c(".value", "strike"),
    names_sep = "_",
    values_drop_na = TRUE)

longData$strike <- as.factor(longData$strike)

write.csv(longData, "../Analyses/Control-Pilot_Clean_Long.csv")
